TITLE:
The top line or the bottom line —
which one is longer?
NEXT: NEXT: Two circles in the middle — which one is bigger?

EN.가운데 선만 보세요\n위와 아래, 어느 쪽이 길까요?:
Look only at the middle lines.
Top or bottom — which is longer?
EN.아래 선이 더 길어 보이죠?: The bottom one looks longer, right?
EN.위 선의 끝에서\n세로줄을 쭉 내려 볼게요:
Let's draw lines straight down
from the ends of the top line
EN.어? 아래 선 끝에\n딱 맞아요!:
Huh? They hit the ends
of the bottom line exactly!
EN.자를 대 볼까요?: Let's measure them with a ruler
EN.그냥 같은 길이의 두 선: …and they're just two lines of the same length
EN.다시 붙이면…\n알고 봐도 또 아래가 길어 보여요!:
Put them back on…
even now that you know, the bottom still looks longer!
EN.뇌는 가운데 선만\n따로 재지 않아요:
Your brain doesn't measure
the middle line on its own
EN.끝에 붙은 모양까지\n한 덩어리로 보고 길이를 짐작해요:
It takes in the shapes on the ends too,
and guesses the length from the whole thing
EN.벌어진 끝은 덩어리가 크니까\n선도 길다고 느껴요:
Ends that spread out make the whole thing bigger,
so the line feels longer
EN.정확히 왜 그런지는\n과학자들도 아직 연구 중이에요:
Exactly why this happens
is something scientists are still studying
EN.종이에 똑같이 그려서\n친구에게 물어보세요:
Draw it on paper
and try it on a friend
EN.같은 길이도 끝 모양에 따라\n다르게 보여요:
The same length can look different
depending on the ends
